items.summary: Legal risk disposition: blocked for the gated product's public beta or full launch; counsel_required for upstream data rights, jurisdiction-specific privacy treatment, vendor/DPA obligations, and future affiliate or advertising use; conditional for ordinary reversible fleet growth. Exact decision: keep the gated product private. Evidence: official API documentation establishes access mechanics only; current terms do not establish rights to store, transform, cache, publicly display, retain historical derivatives, send alerts, or monetize returned data. Compliance is a technical baseline only: 35 pass, 14 fail, 10 unknown. Analytics is yellow with source/permission gaps. Revenue evidence covers 2026-09-21 only: $4.92 aggregate commission and $0 site-attributed commission. Do not claim certification, ROI, margin, causal lift, or site-attributed revenue. Ordinary growth may continue only when it preserves existing consent, cookie/analytics disclosure, affiliate disclosure, claims substantiation, provenance and rights, copyright/trademark boundaries, platform-policy limits, and applicable regulated or age-sensitive safeguards. Do not create new tracking, monetization expansion, rights-dependent content, public exposure, or unsupported claims.

Launch-readiness tracking remains active: 0 of 4 legal tasks are closed. Partial evidence exists for API documentation and terms, repository/configuration data-flow files, privacy and cookie pages, and draft terms; no task is closable. Open tasks remain source rights, alert-data retention and user workflows, GA4 consent/configuration, and logs/vendors/incident handling. Next evidence action: attach one consolidated read-only evidence bundle and field-level rights matrix covering source fields, provenance, permitted storage/display/alerts, freshness, correction, takedown, identifiers, retention, deletion, access, notification consent, unsubscribe behavior, GA4 settings, log fields, vendor/DPA coverage, and incident/request procedures. Keep outreach unsent and preserve the private gate.

Data-use review: Woot API deal and price-history data = counsel_required and launch-blocked. Missing current written permission or API agreement; field-level provenance and rights; caching, display, alert, attribution, freshness, correction, takedown, trademark, image, price, affiliate, and advertising limits. Smallest next action: complete the field-level rights matrix and route the unsent permission package for human-counsel review. User alert rules and sync results = evidence_needed; missing data inventory, identifiers, retention, deletion, correction, access workflow, processor terms, notification consent, and unsubscribe behavior. Smallest next action: produce the repository and deployed data-flow and retention table. GA4 analytics = evidence_needed; missing deployed consent and withdrawal behavior, GA4 property and data-sharing settings, retention settings, and jurisdictional review. Smallest next action: capture existing consent and GA4 configuration without enabling tracking. Operational logs and Cloudflare hosting data = evidence_needed; missing log-field inventory, retention/access controls, vendor/DPA review, and incident/request procedures. Smallest next action: produce a read-only operator and vendor inventory and identify counsel-required gaps.

Compliance and evidence boundary: do not treat incomplete telemetry as a general growth blocker. Current compliance results are 35 pass, 14 fail, and 10 unknown; site-specific failures, unknown reachability, missing consent controls, missing terms, or missing disclosures remain launch/compliance issues for the affected site. Analytics coverage is yellow and revenue attribution is partial aggregate: retain the $4.92 aggregate commission as unattributed and do not infer zero performance from missing data. Private or gated sites require an explicit keep-private decision and completed checklist before exposure.
